summary: Phase 2 testing PASSED end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 new pytest cases (test_phase2.py) green including Acceptance Criterion #7 (collect 25000 -> auto-allocates 20000 to oldest T1 fully-settling it, then 5000 to newer T2, leaves party_outstanding=5000). Verified oldest-first ordering & required shape of GET /api/parties/{pid}/open-trips; buckets & phone on GET /api/pending-freight (older trip aged 45d -> 31_60 bucket ₹20k, newer aged 10d -> 0_15 bucket ₹10k); trips.settled_amount/pending_freight updated after collect; manual allocations override auto (paid newer trip first, older stayed pending); over-allocation caps at each trip's pending (₹5000 collect on ₹1000 outstanding allocated only ₹1000); annual endpoint returns 12 months Apr..Mar with totals block. Frontend (mobile viewport, token injected via add_init_script): (1) /pending renders 2 party cards (Shakti Steels ₹68k with 3 trips + ABC Traders ₹5k with 1 trip), ageing bar + colour legend (0-15/16-30/31-60/60+), Collect & Remind buttons per card, and a grand-total pill ₹73,000 in header. (2) /collect/{pid} shows Total outstanding, amount input, Full button, three payment-mode chips (Cash/UPI/Bank), reference input, and live auto-allocation (oldest-first) preview — typing 100 correctly showed +₹100 against the oldest trip S3 (2026-06-02) and 0 against S2/S1; submit button visible. (3) /annual renders KPI cards (Revenue / Net Profit / Received / Pending), Net Profit bar chart, 12 monthly-row table, FY prev/next arrows work — clicking fy-next changed header from FY 2026-27 to FY 2027-28. (4) All 5 bottom tabs present (Today, Trips, Pending, P&L, More). P&L header has annual-btn present; More screen has more-annual link plus vehicles/drivers/parties/categories/import. Only cosmetic RN-web deprecation warnings (props.pointerEvents, TouchableMixin) — no red screen, no functional bugs.

react_native_issues.issue: On the Collect screen a bunch of RN gesture handlers (onStartShouldSetResponder, onResponderGrant/Move/Release/Terminate, onResponderTerminationRequest, onPressOut) are being forwarded to a DOM element on web preview, producing 'Unknown event handler property' errors. Likely due to a TouchableMixin/legacy Touchable wrapper (see 'TouchableMixin is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' warning). Non-blocking on web but should be migrated. Reference: /app/frontend/app/collect/[partyId].tsx
props.pointerEvents deprecation warning still appears (already reported in iter 2 as unresolved).

action_items: (Cosmetic) Migrate the legacy Touchable* usage on /collect/[partyId].tsx to Pressable to silence the onResponder*/onPressOut 'Unknown event handler' console errors on web.
(Cosmetic) Migrate remaining props.pointerEvents usages to style.pointerEvents (carry-over from iter 2).
critical_code_review_comments: server._compute_trip correctly uses pending_freight = revenue - amount_received - settled_amount — matches the PRD; verified numerically.
collect_payment auto-allocation sorts open_trips by t['date'] ASC (oldest first) before allocating; manual override path is honored when body.allocations is provided.

collect_payment does NOT enforce an upper cap when body.amount exceeds total outstanding — however auto-alloc naturally caps because it uses min(remaining, pending) per trip; excess money is simply not allocated (allocated < amount) and party_outstanding becomes 0. Consider returning 'excess' in the response to make this explicit for the UI, or rejecting/warning when amount > outstanding.
pending_freight endpoint correctly buckets by age using calendar days from today; parties with 0 pending are excluded (verified after collect).
annual_pnl re-invokes monthly_pnl per month; fine for 12 iterations but if trips scale up consider aggregating in a single DB pass.
delete_receipt route is missing (POST /api/receipts/collect creates rows but there is no cleanup endpoint). Not a Phase-2 blocker but worth noting for maintenance/testing.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 Phase 2 + all 27 regression from iter 1 remain green)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of Phase 2 flows (Pending tab, Collect screen live preview, Annual dashboard w/ FY navigation, 5 bottom tabs, P&L annual-btn, More annual link)
